title: Professional Identity & Current Role
content: Thigulla Meghraj Goud (Meghraj) is a Senior AI Developer and Full Stack Engineer based in Hyderabad, India. Since July 2024, he works at Threshing Floor Group (TFG) Pvt Ltd, building production AI/ML services, backend architectures, and mobile applications.

title: Verified Production Milestones
content: Across production systems, Meghraj has delivered backend infrastructure with 286 endpoints, 61+ database models, and 30+ Alembic/Prisma schema migrations. He has shipped 80+ mobile screens and 96+ web interfaces, owned App Store/Play Store deployments for 4+ Flutter apps, and led knowledge transfer for 8 engineers.

title: Education & Core Technical Foundation
content: Meghraj holds a Bachelor of Technology (B.Tech) in Information Technology from Vignana Bharathi Institute of Technology (VBIT), Hyderabad (2020 — 2024). His technical foundation covers distributed systems, databases, machine learning, and secure software development.

title: Availability & Engagement Scope
content: Meghraj is available for enterprise technical consulting and senior AI/backend engineering roles (Remote or Hybrid). Primary target areas include backend systems engineering, ML model serving gateways, and end-to-end mobile app delivery.

title: TFGenAPI — Verification & Custom API Platform
content: TFGenAPI is a verification and custom API platform built from scratch. Meghraj engineered the AI inference pipeline utilizing PyTesseract for OCR and Sentence Transformers for dense vector embeddings, configured a Motor/MongoDB data layer for unstructured ingestion, and integrated Celery/Redis task queues for async processing. Stack: Next.js 16, Python, FastAPI, MongoDB, Redis, PyTesseract, Sentence Transformers.

title: IYOV AI — Workforce Management Ecosystem
content: IYOV AI is an AI-powered multi-tenant workforce management SaaS. Meghraj built the India statutory compliance and tax payroll engine from scratch, automated batch processing and worker notifications via Redis job queues, and published 4+ companion Flutter apps (Employee Portal, HRMS, LMS, Care Navigator) to the App Store and Google Play Store. Stack: Python, FastAPI, Flutter, Riverpod, Next.js, PostgreSQL, Redis.

title: TFG SecureBank — Digital Fintech Application
content: TFG SecureBank is a secure digital fintech application. Meghraj architected a multi-tenant FastAPI backend with 70 REST endpoints routing between PostgreSQL/Supabase and legacy MySQL. He created an automated credit validation rules engine using openpyxl and xlcalculator, and generated tamper-evident loan agreement documents with WeasyPrint. Stack: Python, FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, Alembic, PostgreSQL, Redis, WeasyPrint.

title: Medical Advisor — Healthcare Diagnostic Gateway
content: Medical Advisor is a clinical diagnostic and consultation gateway. Meghraj unified disparate model inference services into a resilient gateway and established the core platform architecture. This project served as the knowledge transfer entry point where Meghraj personally mentored and trained 8 engineers on platform systems.

title: DealsMart — E-Commerce Retail Platform
content: DealsMart is a high-availability retail e-commerce platform. Meghraj designed the backend catalog services and product search caching layers to support heavy consumer traffic and high-throughput checkout workflows.

title: Engineering Capabilities & Core Stack
content: Meghraj's core strengths span backend infrastructure (Python, FastAPI, Express, PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis, Docker), client & mobile platforms (Flutter/Dart, Next.js, React, TypeScript), and practical AI/ML engineering (ONNX Runtime, PaddleOCR, PyTesseract, Sentence Transformers, model serving gateways).

title: Public Information & Privacy Boundaries
content: To protect client confidentiality and personal privacy: proprietary internal database schemas and unannounced partner contracts are strictly confidential; personal phone numbers are not published on the web; and rate/compensation discussions are conducted exclusively via direct private correspondence.
